# Buchan's Kerrisdale Stationery

> A Vancouver-based premium pen and stationery retailer offering curated collections of writing instruments, notebooks, planners, and gifts from international brands.

Buchan's Kerrisdale Stationery is a specialty stationery shop located in Vancouver, Canada, specializing in high-quality pens from brands like LAMY, Kaweco, Sailor, and Pilot, alongside notebooks, planners, and writing accessories. The store serves both local customers and ships across Canada and the USA.

## Key Topics

- Fountain Pens

## Writing Instruments & Pens

- [Shop Pens for the Best Prices](https://www.buchanst.com/collections/pens): Main pen shop collection featuring LAMY, Sailor, Pilot and other premium pen brands.
- [Ballpoint Pens](https://www.buchanst.com/collections/ballpoint-pens): Ballpoint pen collection from Lamy, Kaweco, Sailor, Cross and Diplomat brands.
- [Rollerball Pens](https://www.buchanst.com/collections/rollerball-pens): Rollerball pen selection from KAWECO, Lamy, Diplomat, Parker and Retro1951.
- [Calligraphy Sets, Pens, Inks & Markers](https://www.buchanst.com/collections/calligraphy): Calligraphy supplies including dip pens, brush pens and inks from Kuretake and Platinum.

## Fountain Pen Supplies

- [Fountain Pen Ink](https://www.buchanst.com/collections/fountain-pen-inks): 100+ fountain pen ink colors from Sailor, Platinum and Ink Studio brands.
- [Fountain Pen Ink Cartridge](https://www.buchanst.com/collections/fountain-pen-ink-cartridge): Ink cartridge refills for LAMY, KAWECO, PLATINUM and PILOT fountain pens.

## Notebooks & Journals

- [Notebooks & Notepads](https://www.buchanst.com/collections/notebooks): Notebook collection featuring Fabriano, Midori, Rhodia and Traveler's notebooks.
- [Traveler's Notebooks](https://www.buchanst.com/collections/travelers-notebooks): Traveler's Notebook starter kits and refills in regular and passport sizes.
- [Note Pads](https://www.buchanst.com/collections/note-pads): Note pad collection from Rhodia, Midori and G. LALO brands.

## Planning & Organization

- [2026 Planners & Agenda](https://www.buchanst.com/collections/2026-planners-agendas): 2026 daily, weekly and monthly planners from Paperblanks, Moleskine and Leuchtturm.
- [Organizers](https://www.buchanst.com/collections/organizers): Organizers and office accessories from Traveler's Company and LEGAMI brands.
- [Desktop & Wall Calendars 2025](https://www.buchanst.com/collections/desktop-wall-calendars): 2025 desktop and wall calendars with Canadian themes and premium designs.

## Cards & Gifts

- [Greeting Cards](https://www.buchanst.com/collections/greeting-cards): Greeting cards and pop-up cards for various occasions from multiple brands.
- [Boxed Cards](https://www.buchanst.com/collections/boxed-cards): Boxed card sets from Caspari, Peter Pauper Press and Rossi 1931.
- [Guestbooks](https://www.buchanst.com/collections/guestbooks): Guestbooks from Peter Pauper Press, Paperblanks and Amscan brands.

## Customer Service & Support

- [Shipping & Returns](https://www.buchanst.com/pages/returns-shipping): Shipping and returns policy covering Canada, US, customs duties, and refund procedures.

- [Coloring Books](https://www.buchanst.com/collections/coloring-books): Adult and children's coloring book collection available in Vancouver.
